name: dobe_hug_tight
desc: keep the blue pillar exactly the same. The pink goo doberman hugs the pillar much more tightly: its body is pressed hard against the pillar, its shoulders hunched forward, its arm wrapped further around and squeezing firmly, its head buried close against the pillar with the eyes hidden, the goo of its body squished and merged onto the pillar. Same pink colors, size, lower body and pixel art style.
